# TurboQuant.net (https://turboquant.net)

> Independent technical analysis, paper walkthrough, and engine integration status guide for Google Research's TurboQuant (arXiv:2504.19874), PolarQuant (arXiv:2502.02617), and QJL KV-cache compression. Unofficial.

## Core Guides

- [TurboQuant Overview & Benchmarks](https://turboquant.net/)
- [TurboQuant Paper Explained (PolarQuant + QJL)](https://turboquant.net/paper/)
- [How to Use TurboQuant (vLLM, MLX, llama.cpp, LM Studio Status)](https://turboquant.net/guide/)
- [About TurboQuant.net](https://turboquant.net/about/)
